SELECT fsp.base_price AS basePrice, fsp.current_price AS currentPrice, fsp.last_event_priced_at AS lastEventPricedAt, f.departure_time AS departureTime,
CASE WHEN fsp.cabin_class_code = 'ECO' THEN fi.economy_class_seat WHEN fsp.cabin_class_code = 'BIZ' THEN fi.business_class_seat WHEN fsp.cabin_class_code = 'FST' THEN fi.first_class_seat END AS remainingSeats,
CASE WHEN fsp.cabin_class_code = 'ECO' THEN ac.economy_class_seats WHEN fsp.cabin_class_code = 'BIZ' THEN ac.business_class_seats WHEN fsp.cabin_class_code = 'FST' THEN ac.first_class_seats END AS totalSeats
FROM flight_seat_price fsp JOIN flight f ON f.flight_id = fsp.flight_id JOIN flight_info fi ON fi.flight_id = f.flight_id JOIN aircraft ac ON ac.aircraft_id = fi.aircraft_id WHERE fsp.flight_id = #{flightId} AND fsp.cabin_class_code = #{cabinClassCode} FOR UPDATE
